headline: Colonials Reclaim Dead Lands Ruin; Weathered Expanse Blazes On
war_summary: The chief change since our last edition stands in the Dead Lands, where the demolished work beside Callahan's Boot has passed back into Colonial hands, leaving the wreck in Godcrofts the only ruin on the board. The Dead Lands remains the costliest field — some 20,500 casualties in a day, the Warden share the heavier — while Weathered Expanse burns on with twenty-three actions in the same span, six in the past two hours, most at Spirit Watch, and the losses there running nearly even. In Stonecradle the grind about The Long Fast and The Cord goes on, fifteen events logged, one falling as this edition closed. Stlican Shelf, by contrast, has gone quiet: no actions in two hours, though the Wardens still hold seven of its nine works, The Pale House having seen eighteen blows in the day. Callahan's Passage shows no flag change in six hours, yet its casualty rate sharpens sharply; Linn of Mercy bleeds near 9,000 in a day without a single base action. The full board reads 261 works to the Colonials, 174 to the Wardens, one in ruin. It is the 167th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
